blocks.text:
At 19: 00 arrival at the International  Jorge Chavez airport in Lima. You will be met and transferred to the hotel.

(Chevrolet Suburban; duration: 45 min)

Accommodation in Belmond Miraflores Park (Ocean View Club Junior Suite).

At 20: 45 transfer to the restaurant “Rafael”(Chevrolet Suburban, guide and vehicle at your service for 3 hours) 

At 21: 00  - Dinner reservation (not included).

Return to the hotel. Overnight in Lima. 

For this journey, pack for very different conditions. Light clothing and sun protection will be useful in Lima. The Amazon is humid and clothes get wet more quickly, so bring spare clothing and long sleeves and trousers for the evenings. Lightweight footwear that stays securely on your feet is practical for the water and jungle. Cusco and the Sacred Valley are cooler, especially in the mornings and evenings, so bring a warm layer.
